name: nim
description: Nim generates images and videos from ChatGPT using a range of AI models. Prompt-writing skills help turn a short request into a detailed, model-specific prompt. Browse templates for common creative tasks and upload your own photos and clips as references. Tools cover lip sync and image and video upscaling. Follow each generation as it runs and check your credit balance in the chat. Generations use credits from your Nim account, and results vary by model and prompt.

defaultPrompt: Create a product ad image from my photo, keeping the product, logo, colors and packaging recognizable.
Create a short UGC-style video ad for my product with a hook and natural delivery.
Plan a product launch campaign with images, short videos and creative concepts for each platform.
interface.longDescription: Nim generates images and videos from ChatGPT using a range of AI models. Prompt-writing skills help turn a short request into a detailed, model-specific prompt. Browse templates for common creative tasks and upload your own photos and clips as references. Tools cover lip sync and image and video upscaling. Follow each generation as it runs and check your credit balance in the chat. Generations use credits from your Nim account, and results vary by model and prompt.

positive.description: Generate an image from a text prompt and show the finished result.
positive.prompt: Use Nim to create a cinematic 16:9 image of a glass greenhouse on Mars at sunset.
positive.expected_behavior: Nim picks a compatible image model and starts one 16:9 image generation. The Nim generation widget shows progress and then the finished image; without the widget, the assistant reports the finished image from get_generation_status.

positive.description: Generate a short vertical video from a text prompt.
positive.prompt: With Nim, make a 5-second vertical 9:16 video of ocean waves rolling onto a beach at golden hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Nim picks a compatible video model and starts one 5-second 9:16 video generation. The Nim generation widget shows progress and then the finished video; without the widget, the assistant reports the finished video from get_generation_status.

positive.description: Browse templates and inspect the inputs of one template without running it.
positive.prompt: Show me Nim templates for product advertising videos and tell me which inputs the first one needs.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching Nim template cards and lists the required inputs of the first template. No generation starts and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Recommend a video model and compare its cost with the account balance.
positive.prompt: Which Nim video model is best for realistic human motion, and how many credits would a 5-second clip cost compared to my current balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends a video model from Nim's catalog with its credit cost for a 5-second clip and reports the account's current credit balance. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Design a narrator voice and play short voice samples.
positive.prompt: Use Nim to design a warm, calm female narrator voice and let me hear a few samples.
positive.expected_behavior: Generates a few short voice previews for the described voice and shows them in the Nim voice samples widget with playable audio; without the widget, the assistant lists the sample audio links.

negative.description: A conceptual filmmaking question needs no Nim workflow, so the assistant answers directly without calling Nim tools.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a dolly shot and a zoom shot.

negative.description: Searching the public web for stock footage is outside Nim's tools, so Nim is not invoked.
negative.prompt: Search the web for free stock footage of mountain trails.

negative.description: Nim's tools cannot delete generations, so Nim is not invoked and the assistant explains that bulk deletion is not supported.
negative.prompt: Delete every generation in my Nim account.

publication.release_notes: Packages the Nim MCP server with Nim's creative skills for image, video, template and upscaling workflows. Nothing is sold in ChatGPT; Nim works with the user's existing Nim account.
